{{- /* One footer icon as a shared file instead of inline SVG. The footer's icons (the feed's social buttons, the AI providers) are 48px dark tiles with a white glyph, 2–6 KB each. Inlined, they were about 35 KB of every page, the same bytes on each of the thousands of API reference pages. Here the tile (the first two paths: the gradient square and its outline) is cut off at build time, and the glyph is published once as a fingerprinted .svg. The page gets an empty span that paints currentColor through the file as a CSS mask (.gd-footer-glyph in main.css.tmpl), so the icon still follows the theme and the hover colour. A mask uses only the glyph's alpha, so its own fills (white, Perplexity's inner mask) don't matter. tests/footer-data.test.mjs pins the tile-then-glyph shape this relies on. Expects: the raw SVG string. Returns the span, or "" for an empty icon. */ -}} {{- $out := "" -}} {{- with . -}} {{- $glyph := replaceRE `^\s*(]*>)\s*]*/>\s*]*/>` "$1" . 1 -}} {{- if eq $glyph . -}} {{- warnf "footer: an icon doesn't start with the two tile paths; publishing it whole" -}} {{- end -}} {{- $file := resources.FromString (printf "footer-icons/%s.svg" (md5 $glyph)) $glyph | minify | fingerprint -}} {{- $out = printf `` $file.RelPermalink -}} {{- end -}} {{- return ($out | safeHTML) -}}
